strings.action.usa.brief_markets.description: Treasury calls the primary dealers and foreign holders: the government will pay, whatever happens in Congress.
strings.action.usa.brief_markets.name: Brief markets and creditors
strings.action.usa.bully_pulpit_tour.description: Travel to swing districts and make the case for a fix. Raises the pressure on the other side; costs you if it fails.
strings.action.usa.bully_pulpit_tour.name: Rally tour on the debt limit
strings.action.usa.leaders_summit.description: Invite the four leaders to the White House. Talks don't guarantee a deal, but the public sees you trying.
strings.action.usa.leaders_summit.name: Summon congressional leaders
strings.action.usa.shutdown_contingency.descript: Use carry-over funds to pay air traffic controllers and keep national parks open during a shutdown.
strings.action.usa.shutdown_contingency.name: Keep essential services open
strings.action.usa.workforce_order.description: Reclassify policy roles and speed up dismissals. Your base cheers; unions and civil servants don't.
strings.action.usa.workforce_order.name: Executive order on the federal workforce
strings.crisis.usa.constitutional_showdown.argum: Oral argument. Markets trade on every question from the bench.
strings.crisis.usa.constitutional_showdown.filin: Members of Congress and bondholders sue. Some lenders refuse new Treasury debt until the courts rule.
strings.crisis.usa.constitutional_showdown.respo: Offer to drop it the day Congress passes a clean fix.
Put the Solicitor General's best case forward in public.
strings.crisis.usa.constitutional_showdown.settl: The legal fight is over, one way or the other.
strings.crisis.usa.constitutional_showdown.title: Constitutional showdown
strings.crisis.usa.shutdown.furloughs: Agencies have closed. Paychecks stop for federal workers; parks and offices shut.
strings.crisis.usa.shutdown.reopened: The government has reopened. Back pay is on its way.
strings.crisis.usa.shutdown.response.essential: Keep essential services running from carry-over funds.
strings.crisis.usa.shutdown.strain: Missed paychecks, airport delays and closed courts. Patience is running out on all sides.
strings.crisis.usa.shutdown.title: Government shutdown
strings.crisis.usa.xdate_crunch.averted: The limit is fixed. Markets exhale; the bill for the scare comes later.
strings.crisis.usa.xdate_crunch.countdown: The last days before the X-date. Every morning brings a new Treasury letter and a worse market open.
strings.crisis.usa.xdate_crunch.final_days: Days, not weeks. Agencies draw up lists of which bills to pay first.
strings.crisis.usa.xdate_crunch.missed: The Treasury has missed payments. Every day without a fix makes the damage worse.
strings.crisis.usa.xdate_crunch.response.address: Address the nation: explain what a default would mean.
strings.crisis.usa.xdate_crunch.response.markets: Have the Fed and Treasury brief markets every day.
strings.crisis.usa.xdate_crunch.title: X-date crunch
strings.event.usa.airport_delays.text: Air traffic control staffing shortages ground flights at major hubs.
strings.event.usa.airport_delays.title: Airport delays as controllers call in sick
strings.event.usa.base_backlash_dem.text: Progressive groups call the deal a betrayal. Some are already polling a primary challenge.
strings.event.usa.base_backlash_dem.title: Progressives turn on the deal
strings.event.usa.base_backlash_rep.text: Conservative groups call the deal a tax hike in disguise. Some are already polling a primary challenge.
strings.event.usa.base_backlash_rep.title: Conservatives turn on the deal
strings.event.usa.business_leaders_letter.text: Chief executives of 150 large companies call on both parties to raise the limit now.
strings.event.usa.business_leaders_letter.title: Business leaders urge a deal
strings.event.usa.cabinet_resignation_threat.opt: Get a formal legal opinion first.
strings.event.usa.cabinet_resignation_threat.tex: A senior Treasury official tells the Secretary she will resign rather than carry out an unlawful payment plan.
strings.event.usa.cds_spike.text: The price of insuring against a US default has passed its 2011 and 2023 highs.
strings.event.usa.cds_spike.title: Default insurance on US debt hits a record
strings.event.usa.china_reviewing_holdings.optio: Have Treasury call its counterpart in Beijing.
strings.event.usa.china_reviewing_holdings.text: A financial paper reports that Beijing's reserve managers were told to prepare for a US payment delay.
strings.event.usa.china_reviewing_holdings.title: Leak: China 'reviewing' its Treasury holdings
strings.event.usa.countdown_special.text: Every channel now runs a ticking clock. Viewers are anxious and want someone to blame.
strings.event.usa.countdown_special.title: Cable news 'Default Countdown'
strings.event.usa.court_accepts_case.text: The Court agrees to hear the challenge to the administration's unilateral debt plan on an expedited schedule.
strings.event.usa.court_accepts_case.title: Supreme Court takes the debt case
strings.event.usa.creditor_summit.option.decline: Decline: there will be no default to plan for.
strings.event.usa.creditor_summit.text: The UK and the EU propose a finance ministers' call on 'contingency arrangements' should the US miss a payment.
strings.event.usa.creditor_summit.title: Invitation to a creditor summit
strings.event.usa.fed_holds_firm.text: The Fed chair tells Congress the central bank has no tools to prevent the damage of a missed payment.
strings.event.usa.fed_holds_firm.title: Fed chair: 'we will not monetise a default'
strings.event.usa.federal_workers_protest.text: Thousands of unpaid workers march on the Capitol, joined by union leaders.
strings.event.usa.federal_workers_protest.title: Federal workers rally in Washington
strings.event.usa.gang_of_ten.text: Ten senators from both parties start meeting on a debt-limit framework.
strings.event.usa.gang_of_ten.title: A bipartisan 'gang' forms
strings.event.usa.gas_prices_climb.text: Pump prices are up 40 cents since spring, ahead of the driving season.
strings.event.usa.gas_prices_climb.title: Gas prices climb into summer
strings.event.usa.gulf_flareup.text: A tanker was hit off the Strait of Hormuz; oil jumped 15% overnight.
strings.event.usa.gulf_flareup.title: Tanker attacked in the Gulf
strings.event.usa.heatwave_grid.text: Rolling blackouts hit Texas and California for three days.
strings.event.usa.heatwave_grid.title: Heat wave strains the power grid
strings.event.usa.hurricane.option.emergency_aid: Ask Congress for emergency aid now.
strings.event.usa.hurricane.option.existing_fund: Use the disaster fund already appropriated.
strings.event.usa.hurricane.text: A Category 3 storm floods coastal towns. Governors ask for federal disaster aid.
strings.event.usa.hurricane.title: Hurricane makes landfall on the Gulf Coast
strings.event.usa.inflation_surprise.text: Consumer prices rose faster than forecast. Markets now expect the Fed to stay tight for longer.
strings.event.usa.inflation_surprise.title: Inflation comes in hot
strings.event.usa.japan_reassurance.option.reass: Promise the bonds will be paid whatever happens.
strings.event.usa.japan_reassurance.option.vague: Say Congress will act; it always has.
strings.event.usa.japan_reassurance.text: Tokyo wants to know whether its $1.1 trillion in Treasuries is safe.
strings.event.usa.japan_reassurance.title: Japan's finance minister calls
strings.event.usa.leaked_whip_count.text: A spreadsheet of members' positions leaks to the press, embarrassing several 'undecideds'.
strings.event.usa.leaked_whip_count.title: A whip count leaks
strings.event.usa.market_flash_dip.option.blame: Say the other side is playing with fire.
strings.event.usa.market_flash_dip.option.reassu: Tell markets the government will pay its bills.
strings.event.usa.market_flash_dip.text: The stock market fell sharply in afternoon trading after a report that talks had stalled.
strings.event.usa.market_flash_dip.title: Stocks slide on debt-limit fears
strings.event.usa.op_ed_economists.text: Two hundred economists sign an open letter on the consequences of a default.
strings.event.usa.op_ed_economists.title: Economists warn of a 'self-inflicted recession'
strings.event.usa.own_flank_letter_dem.option.ke: Say everything is on the table.
strings.event.usa.own_flank_letter_dem.text: Sixty House progressives sign a letter: no votes for any deal that cuts benefits or adds work requirements.
strings.event.usa.own_flank_letter_dem.title: Progressives draw a red line
strings.event.usa.own_flank_letter_rep.option.ke: Say a clean bill isn't off the table.
strings.event.usa.own_flank_letter_rep.text: Forty House conservatives sign a letter: no votes for any increase without cuts at least as large.
strings.event.usa.own_flank_letter_rep.title: Hardliners draw a red line
strings.event.usa.parliamentarian_guidance.text: The Senate parliamentarian signals that a debt-limit change can ride on a budget reconciliation bill, if it is written as a number.
strings.event.usa.parliamentarian_guidance.title: Parliamentarian's guidance on budget rules
strings.event.usa.poll_blame.text: A new poll asks who will be responsible if the government misses a payment. The answer splits along party lines, with independents undecided.
strings.event.usa.poll_blame.title: Poll: who is to blame?
strings.event.usa.primary_threat_ads.text: An outside group runs ads against members of your party who won't commit to raising the limit.
strings.event.usa.primary_threat_ads.title: Ads target your party's holdouts
strings.event.usa.seniors_worry.option.plain: Say only Congress can guarantee every payment.
strings.event.usa.seniors_worry.option.promise: Promise benefits will be paid first.
strings.event.usa.seniors_worry.text: Calls flood congressional offices from retirees who fear their benefit payments will stop.
strings.event.usa.seniors_worry.title: Seniors ask about their checks
strings.event.usa.shutdown_furloughs.text: Some 800,000 federal employees are sent home without pay; many more work unpaid.
strings.event.usa.shutdown_furloughs.title: Federal workers furloughed
strings.event.usa.speaker_rebellion.text: A group of the Speaker's own members threaten a vote to remove the chair if a 'surrender' bill comes to the floor.
strings.event.usa.speaker_rebellion.title: Rebellion against the Speaker
strings.event.usa.swing_member_scandal.text: A member you were counting on faces questions over stock trades. Leaders want distance; the member wants your support.
strings.event.usa.swing_member_scandal.title: Swing member in an ethics scandal
strings.event.usa.tbill_kink.text: Yields on Treasury bills that mature just after the projected X-date jump; money funds are dumping them.
strings.event.usa.tbill_kink.title: Bills maturing near the X-date shunned
strings.event.usa.treasury_auction_tails.text: A 10-year note auction drew weak demand and cleared well above the expected yield. Dealers say buyers want a premium for debt-limit risk.
strings.event.usa.treasury_auction_tails.title: Treasury auction tails
strings.event.usa.weak_jobs_report.text: Payrolls grew far less than expected and unemployment ticked up.
strings.event.usa.weak_jobs_report.title: Weak jobs report
strings.event.usa.xdate_crunch_begins.text: The Treasury's latest letter puts the X-date about ten days out. Markets, agencies and foreign governments are preparing for the worst.
strings.event.usa.xdate_crunch_begins.title: Ten days to the X-date
strings.policy.usa.contingency_plan.description: Treasury and the Fed publish how they would keep paying bondholders and roll over maturing debt if the limit binds.
strings.policy.usa.contingency_plan.name: Default contingency plan
strings.policy.usa.corporate_minimum_tax.descrip: A minimum tax on the book profits of large corporations.
strings.policy.usa.corporate_minimum_tax.name: Corporate minimum tax
strings.policy.usa.defense_topup.description: Raises the defence budget above the caps for readiness and procurement.
strings.policy.usa.defense_topup.name: Defence top-up
strings.policy.usa.extend_tax_cuts.description: Extends the individual tax cuts that expire at the end of next year.
strings.policy.usa.extend_tax_cuts.name: Extend expiring tax cuts
strings.policy.usa.fiscal_commission.description: A bipartisan commission to propose long-term deficit reduction, with a guaranteed vote on its plan.
strings.policy.usa.fiscal_commission.name: Fiscal reform commission
strings.policy.usa.fourteenth_amendment.descript: Declares that the validity of the public debt can't be questioned, and keeps borrowing past the debt limit.
strings.policy.usa.fourteenth_amendment.name: Invoke the 14th Amendment
strings.policy.usa.high_earner_surtax.descriptio: A surtax on incomes above one million dollars.
strings.policy.usa.high_earner_surtax.name: Surtax on high earners
strings.policy.usa.hiring_freeze.description: Freezes civilian federal hiring, with exceptions for security and safety.
strings.policy.usa.hiring_freeze.name: Federal hiring freeze
strings.policy.usa.irs_enforcement.description: Funds the tax agency to collect taxes owed but unpaid.
strings.policy.usa.irs_enforcement.name: Tax enforcement funding
strings.policy.usa.large_coin.description: Has the Mint strike a trillion-dollar platinum coin and deposit it at the Fed, funding the government without borrowing.
strings.policy.usa.large_coin.name: Mint a large-denomination coin
strings.policy.usa.nondefense_cuts.description: Cuts non-defence discretionary programmes below last year's level, agency by agency.
strings.policy.usa.nondefense_cuts.name: Discretionary spending cuts
strings.policy.usa.pay_go.description: New mandatory spending or tax cuts must be offset over ten years.
strings.policy.usa.pay_go.name: Pay-as-you-go rule
strings.policy.usa.permitting_reform.description: Shortens environmental reviews for pipelines, grids and mines.
strings.policy.usa.permitting_reform.name: Energy permitting reform
strings.policy.usa.rescind_unspent.description: Claws back appropriated money agencies have not yet spent.
strings.policy.usa.rescind_unspent.name: Rescind unspent funds
strings.policy.usa.spending_freeze.description: Directs agencies to withhold appropriated funds the law doesn't require to be spent at once (impoundment).
strings.policy.usa.spending_freeze.name: Emergency spending freeze
strings.policy.usa.work_requirements.description: Requires able-bodied adults without dependants to work or train to keep food and health benefits.
strings.policy.usa.work_requirements.name: Work requirements for benefits
